registry.descr: The Meta registry that stores this plugin's policies.

contract.name: MetaPlugin
contract.desc: Reusable adapter. Each wallet's delegated grant has a plugin-owned policy in Meta (see GrantPolicyPlugin).

methods.name: configureScope
methods.desc:
Only an administrator execution can create or replace a delegated grant's policy. The grant must
be installed; the policy lapses if the grant is removed and installed again.

methods.name: clearScope
methods.desc: Removing a policy disables the delegated grant until an administrator configures it again.
